axes.name: ecosystem
axes.doc: The registry or platform, named for people.

axes.name: detection_files
axes.doc: The manifests whose presence in a directory declares the target.

axes.name: content_based_detection
axes.doc: Whether detection also reads the manifest's content.

axes.name: version_files
axes.doc: The files a version write changes.

axes.name: companion_tag
axes.doc: The extra tag a member of this target owes a release besides the releasable's own tag, or empty.

axes.name: registry_display_name
axes.doc: How the registry is spelled in output.

axes.name: build_timeout_seconds
axes.doc: Seconds the release's build of the target may take; 0 when the release builds nothing for it.

axes.name: project_init_hint
axes.doc: What creates a project of this target.

axes.name: publisher_binds_to_repository
axes.doc: Whether publishing is authorized for a repository rather than by a token, so moving the code needs a new authorization.

axes.name: publisher_setup_url
axes.doc: Where a repository-bound publisher is registered; empty when none is.

axes.name: release_materialization_policy
axes.doc: Whether a reconcile may recreate a released version's missing refs unconditionally, or must refuse when the version was released under another identity.

axes.name: package_rename
axes.doc: How rlsbl rewrite project-name renames the package: manifest-field or go-module-path.

axes.name: package_name_field
axes.doc: Where the package name is declared.

axes.name: builtin_test_command
axes.doc: What the built-in test runner runs.

axes.name: test_settings
axes.doc: The keys of a member's test table the target reads.

axes.name: dev_install_global
axes.doc: What rlsbl dev install runs to install onto the machine; empty when nothing.

axes.name: dev_install_venv
axes.doc: What rlsbl dev install runs to install into the project's environment; empty when nothing.

axes.name: shares_workspace_environment
axes.doc: Whether a workspace's members of this target resolve into one environment.

axes.name: publish_workflow_attests
axes.doc: Whether the CI publish step attaches attestations to a public transparency log unless told not to.

axes.name: supports_dep_floors
axes.doc: Whether the manifest states dependency floors a lockfile can resolve ahead of.

axes.name: lists_upload_offline
axes.doc: Whether the files an upload carries are listed without the network, so private paths are refused before a release starts.

axes.name: scratch_test_exclusion
axes.doc: How the target's own test runner is kept out of the scratch directories.

targets.name: go
targets.companion_tag: {path}/v{version}, or v{version} at the repository root
targets.package_name_field: go.mod module directive (its last path element)
